title: Storyline Day 5: DCSync Replication & Service Persistence on GOAD KingsLanding
description: Detects Day 5 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: Active Directory DCSync replication rights abuse (EventID 4662 DS-Replication-Get-Changes) on GOAD-DC01 (kingslanding) paired with Windows service installation persistence (EventID 7045 / 4698).
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event System Logs') and ('Event ID' in ('4662', '7045', '4698') and 'Host Name (Server)' in ('kingslanding', 'winterfell', 'castelblack')) | stats count as persistence_events, distinctcount('Event ID') as event_types by 'Host Name (Server)', User | sort -persistence_events
falsepositives: Legitimate Domain Controller computer accounts (ending in $) performing Active Directory replication
investigation_notes: Confirm whether User performing EventID 4662 with GUID 1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2 is a non-DC user account such as petyr.baelish.
Check EventID 7045 Service File Name for C:\Users\Public\splunkd.exe or unauthorized C2 endpoints.
